chunks: About a woman who performed sa‘i between al-Safā and al-Marwah, then menstruated during it, so he said: “She should complete her sa‘i.”
And he asked him about a woman who performed tawaf of the House, then menstruated before doing sa‘i. He said: “She should perform sa‘i.”

key_terms.الصَّفَا: al-Safā, one of the two points of sa‘i
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: al-Marwah, the other point of sa‘i
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: of the House, meaning the Ka‘bah
key_terms.سَعْيَهَا: her sa‘i, the ritual walking between al-Safā and al-Marwah
key_terms.طَافَتْ: she performed the ritual circumambulation or movement in the rite mentioned

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman perform or complete sa‘i between al-Safā and al-Marwah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman during the rites of hajj or ‘umrah. It states that menstruation does not prevent her from completing sa‘i between al-Safā and al-Marwah, whether menstruation begins during the sa‘i or after tawaf and before sa‘i.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2757 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a woman who began her sa‘i between Safa and Marwa but started menstruating before completing it.
Imam (as) said: "She should complete her sa‘i."
He also asked about a woman who performed tawaf around the Kaaba and then menstruated before performing sa‘i.
Imam (as) said: "She should perform sa‘i."
